title: Inventory Handler / Warehouse Executive
description:
Role & Responsibilities Manage day-to-day inventory and warehouse operations , ensuring smooth and accurate stock movement. Handle inwarding, receiving, checking, tagging, put-away, picking, packing and dispatch of products. Maintain accurate SKU-wise inventory , including style, size, colour and category. Ensure 100% inventory accuracy between physical stock and system records. Conduct regular stock counts, cycle counts and physical inventory audits and resolve discrepancies. Coordinate with the D2C/e-commerce, customer service and logistics teams for timely order fulfillment. Ensure all customer orders are picked, checked and packed accurately within defined dispatch timelines. Manage returns, exchanges and RTO inventory , including quality checks and re-stocking. Monitor damaged, defective, missing and ageing inventory and maintain proper records. Ensure premium ethnic garments are handled, folded, stored and packed carefully to maintain product quality. Maintain proper warehouse organization, cleanliness and efficient SKU placement. Coordinate with courier/logistics partners for daily pickups and dispatches . Prepare daily/weekly inventory and warehouse MIS reports . Identify inventory discrepancies and operational issues and take corrective action. Support stock transfers between warehouse, studio, stores, exhibitions or other sales channels, wherever required. Ensure compliance with internal SOPs, inventory controls and warehouse processes . Take ownership of inventory accuracy, order fulfillment and overall warehouse efficiency. Preferred Candidate Profile 3+ years of experience in Inventory Management / Warehouse Operations. Candidates from Fashion, Apparel, Ethnic Wear, Lifestyle, Retail, E-commerce or D2C brands will be preferred. Strong hands-on experience in inventory handling and SKU management . Good understanding of inward, outward, picking, packing, dispatch, returns and stock reconciliation. Experience handling high-value/premium products with attention to product quality and presentation. Good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and inventory management systems. Experience with Shopify, ERP, WMS or e-commerce order management systems will be an added advantage. Strong attention to detail with good numerical and organizational skills. Should be comfortable working in a fast-paced D2C environment and managing daily dispatch deadlines. Strong ownership, accountability and problem-solving skills. Good communication and coordination skills. Should be hands-on and willing to actively participate in warehouse operations , rather than only handling documentation. Candidates who have independently managed inventory/warehouse operations will be preferred. Perks & Benefits 
 Opportunity to work with a premium ethnic fashion D2C brand . High-growth environment with exposure to D2C, e-commerce and omnichannel operations . Opportunity to take ownership of inventory and warehouse processes. Performance-based growth opportunities. Employee discounts on premium ethnic wear. Supportive and collaborative work environment. Opportunity to grow into a Warehouse / Inventory Management leadership role as the business scales.

Key Skills: Store Management,Inventory,Store Operations,Store Operation,Warehouse,Management,Handling,Operations
